name: float-left
note: A single left float followed by a paragraph. Lines overlapping the float's vertical extent are shortened by the float's margin box; the remaining lines use the full content width. Text pixels are compared under the text tier (text-mask.png) because Chrome's Skia rasterizes glyphs slightly differently than @napi-rs/canvas; the line-box geometry itself is verified exactly by layer-3.

harvest.html: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog and runs around the blue box on the left side of this paragraph.
